messages:
Maya: Quick sync — GA readiness for Optimize v1.0. Need final acceptance on SLA, docs, support, monitoring, pricing. Can owners confirm open items by EOD Thu?

Tomas: I'll own SLA + SLO defs. Proposed: 99.9% availability for hosted, p99 latency <150ms for typical generate path; Dedicated baseline 99.5%. Error budget = 0.1% monthly. Need Legal for credits wording.

Cheng: On monitoring — I'll create dashboards + synthetic jobs. Which endpoints should synth tests hit? Suggest /v1/generate and /v1/embed plus a small-size chat flow.

Olivia: Docs scope: quickstart, migration guide (beta -> GA), API changelog, sample rate-limit config, and a short troubleshooting section. I need sample responses and a small prompt+output corpus from runtime.

Pat: Support/ops: plan is 24/7 oncall for Enterprise customers, business-hours for self-serve. Need runbooks: incident triage, fallback-to-variant-model, and SLA credit calc playbook. Who writes runbooks?

Tomas: Eng will draft the SLA page and credits table. I'll produce wording + examples of how credits are computed. Eng-oncall to create the incident playbook skeleton.

Maya: Pricing: confirm final tiers — hosted = per-token (with rate tiers), Dedicated = reserved GPU capacity hourly + commit discounts. Finance needs to run revenue model and invoice simulation. Billing tests required.

Frank: Finance will validate pricing matrix and run simulated invoices next week. Please provide expected monthly volumes per tier.

ops-bot: deployment scheduled: canary rollout for Optimize v1.0 tomorrow 03:00 UTC — watchers: @Tomas @Cheng @Olivia

Olivia: I'll open a docs PR this afternoon with quickstart and sample curl snippets. Will include a short migration note for beta customers.

Cheng: I'll add synthetic probes to monitoring repo and create alert rules: SLO breach alert, increased 5xx rate, cache miss spike, KV-store latency. Also adding smoke test for canary.

Maya: Action items (due EOD Thu):
  1) Tomas — SLA draft + Legal review link
  2) Cheng — monitoring dashboards + synth probes
  3) Olivia — docs PR + sample payloads
  4) Pat/eng-oncall — runbooks + oncall rota
  5) Frank — billing simulation + pricing validation
  6) Eng-oncall — canary smoke run and rollback playbook

Pat: Noted. I'll pull the oncall rota from people-ops and add escalation steps to the runbook.

Maya: Also callout: we need a short public-facing SLA summary and an internal detailed SLA (legal + engineering). Make sure both exist before we publish pricing.

Olivia: PR link: https://git.internal/docs/pr/987 — includes quickstart + sample outputs.

Tomas: SLA draft uploaded: https://drive.internal/sla-drafts/optimize-v1.0.md — pinging @Legal for review.

Legal: Reviewed the draft, looks OK overall. Request adding a Force Majeure clause and data residency/exfiltration limits.

Maya: Great. If no major blockers, we'll finalize the GA checklist by Friday COB and hand off to shiproom for scheduling. :white_check_mark:

Olivia: Sending a short customer migration email template to #marketing after docs land.

Tomas: Will update SLA with Legal changes today.

eng-oncall: Canary smoke completed — minor latency blip in one AZ, rollback policy validated. All clear after 30m monitor.

Maya: Thanks everyone. Reconfirm owners in thread once you've completed your item so I can mark the checklist done. We'll reconvene Thu 10:00 UTC if blockers remain. :rocket:
